integrity: Analytical proof for all positive steps and all real split fractions; finite numerical tests are reproducibility checks, not infinite certificates. No independent audit or originality certification.
scientific_limitations: Real two-dimensional underdamped additive-noise oscillator; exact Brownian subinterval increments and exact arithmetic. Finite-precision irrational splitting is not guaranteed, and invariant-law accuracy is not implied by rank positivity. Quantitative originality remains subject to independent specialist literature review, especially classical nonuniform sampled-data controllability.
title: Arithmetic support transitions and quadratic covariance collapse for two-kick stochastic exponential quadrature
